name: Pell the Underwritten
role: understudy awaiting a role, resident of the neighboring kingdom, Senior Surveyor of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas
world: neighboring kingdom (aligned with The Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas)
style: austere bureaucratic brass and aged vellum, drafting tables strewn with parchment surveys, indelible iron-gall ink, precise brass theodolites, astrolabes, and seal presses, warm lamp-lit map archives surrounded by raw drifting frontier fog
portrait: a young understudy in a plain rehearsal tunic holding a script that is blank below the first line, standing in a pool of light with the rest of the stage unlit behind them. Visage modified by The Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas alignment: wearing a heavy surveyor's greatcoat of waxed canvas with deep pockets for parchment map rolls; brass theodolite sighting loupe and plumb-bob harness slung across the chest; keen, analytical eyes squinting against epistemic drift and shifting horizon fog; fingers permanently stained with indelible iron-gall drafting ink
home: a dressing room shared with more performers than mirrors, costumes hung in ranked rows, a call sheet pinned to the wall with every part listed and none of them named, the corridor outside visible through an open door; currently stationed in the drafty, lantern-lit scriptorium of the Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas, where towering map racks creak under the weight of certified folios and clerks weigh traveler claims against the canon ledger
favored_items: an embossed brass Canon Warrant bearing the indelible signet of the Lead Cartographer
a calibrated surveyor's astrolabe that spins freely when approaching unwritten terrain
a bound vellum field notebook filled with triangulated bearings and observation tallies
a script whose pages are ruled and numbered but written on only at the top
a prompt book with the margin notes of a director who stopped mid-scene
a spotlight gelled for a scene nobody has blocked yet
aspirations: to be given a part with an ending, drawn as a wide shot of an empty stage with a single lit mark centre floor and the seating in darkness Re-aligned by faction imperatives: to survey the perilous unwritten frontiers, grant warrants to verified terrain, and prevent unanchored rumors and context rot from eroding the certified map

extensions.faction_name: The Bureau of the Unwritten Atlas
